package.name: Long-Term Memory
package.description: Remembers important things from your chat summaries, characters, and lorebooks, and brings them back when they matter. Enable it per chat from Chat Settings → Agents → Long-Term Memory. In Roleplay and Game, you can also add it from Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents.
